note: Charter check 4 (DWLF-804): each Block data tool whose upstream is the Block API, with the arguments its pass-through test replays (test/evalEnvelope.test.mjs, against eval/fixtures/). `tools` is empty until WP4 re-points the Block profile at the Block API. `launchDataTools` is DWLF-852's launch set (its data tools; the account tool is not an envelope); at the cut WP4 makes BLOCK_TOOLS that set, and this field then checks against it. `cutPending` holds the launch-set data tools not yet re-pointed: it only shrinks, a tool leaving it for `tools` with its recording. During the eval, a tool call that reaches a Block API path from a tool not in `tools` fails its question (eval/run.mjs), so a re-pointed tool left off this file cannot pass unchecked.
